emotional_tone: Calming, supportive, academic-mindful, non-diagnostic, trustworthy, soft & organic
theme_strategy: Light mode primary with soft mint (#f0fbf9), rich teal (#2a7a72 / #3d998d) accents, deep indigo (#1e1b4b) report covers, warm coral (#f97316 / #fb923c) activity highlights, mint theory blocks (#e6f4f1), and soft lavender (#f3e8ff) calm pills.

typography.heading_font: Playfair Display, Merriweather, or Cormorant Garamond (Serif Display with italic accent words for editorial warmth)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Manrope, or Inter (Clean, highly legible Humanist/Geometric Sans)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (For quantitative scores, scales, data badges)

hierarchy.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
hierarchy.hero_subtitle: text-lg sm:text-xl font-sans text-slate-600 max-w-2xl leading-relaxed
hierarchy.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif text-slate-900 tracking-tight

spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for cards & overlays, rounded-full for pills & badges
spacing_and_layout.shadows: shadow-sm border border-teal-900/10 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

landing_page.hero_section: Soft gradient tint bg (#f0fbf9 to #e6f4f1), floating chat-bubble card showcasing a sample check-in insight, stats row with active student check-in count & 6 wellness domains, serif display headline with italicized keyword 'balanced'.
landing_page.domain_cards: 6 domain tiles (Academic & Workload, Body & Sleep, Emotional Load & Coping, Social & Belonging, Identity & Self-worth, Family Money & Future) with custom mint/teal icons, hover elevation, and brief descriptions.
landing_page.how_it_works: 3-step visual sequence: 1. 24 Quick Questions (10 mins) -> 2. Instant 11-Page AI Report -> 3. 14-Day Actionable Plan.
landing_page.call_to_action: Prominent 'Start 2-Week Stress Check-in' CTA button in deep teal with gentle pulse effect.

assessment_flow.question_card: Centered floating card (max-w-2xl), 1 question visible at a time, smooth slide/fade transition between questions.
assessment_flow.progress_bar: Top sticky smooth progress bar with fraction indicator (e.g., 'Question 7 of 24' & 'Domain: Body & Sleep').
assessment_flow.rating_scale: 5-point scale (0 = Never / Very Rarely, 1 = Seldom, 2 = Sometimes, 3 = Frequently, 4 = Almost Always / Constantly) presented as interactive pill buttons with clear active state and keyboard shortcut support (1-5 keys).

report_viewer_11_sections.page_1_cover: Deep Indigo background (#1b1e3d), white & gold serif text, At-a-Glance summary pill, report generation timestamp, student ID badge.
report_viewer_11_sections.page_2_snapshot: Radar Chart showing scores across 6 domains + 4 quick metric tiles (Overall Stress Index, Dominant Stressor, Resiliency Score, Immediate Focus Area).
report_viewer_11_sections.page_3_narrative: AI-generated narrative summary block in warm serif formatting, highlighting stress feedback loops.
report_viewer_11_sections.pages_4_5_6_priority_areas: Top 3 stress domain deep-dives. Features Mint Theory Block (psychological grounding) paired with Coral Activity Cards (concrete actionable steps).
report_viewer_11_sections.page_7_starter_plan: Interactive 14-Day Starter Plan Grid (5 daily micro-activities x 14 days) with checkable status.
report_viewer_11_sections.page_8_track_reflect: 5-band mood strip (calm to overwhelmed), weekly tracking table, and Sunday guided reflection prompt.
report_viewer_11_sections.page_9_who_can_help: 4-tier support ecosystem (Self-care, Campus Counseling, Peer Support, Professional Crisis Helplines like Tele-MANAS 14416) with copyable script snippets.
report_viewer_11_sections.page_10_worth_ruling_out: Body & physical symptom checklist (sleep apnea, thyroid, vitamin deficiency, burnout signals).
report_viewer_11_sections.page_11_declaration: About EquiMind, non-diagnostic disclaimer, privacy commitment, and export as PDF trigger button.

student_dashboard.header_greeting: Warm personal greeting with last check-in date indicator and retake recommendation timer.
student_dashboard.quick_actions: Buttons for 'New Check-in', 'View Latest Report (PDF)', 'My 14-Day Plan Progress'.
student_dashboard.past_reports_list: Table/Cards of past 2-week check-in history with trend lines and key domain shifts.
student_dashboard.mood_strip_widget: Daily 1-click mood check-in logger with 5 emoji/icon options.

admin_portal.question_bank: Searchable and filterable question repository (180 item pool across 6 domains, target stress weights).
admin_portal.activity_library: Manageable library of activity cards tagged by domain, difficulty, and duration.
admin_portal.aggregate_analytics: Anonymous macro stats across university departments (e.g., peak stress months, most common domain triggers).

interactive_states_and_testing.mandatory_data_testid: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select options, tab buttons, quiz choices, checkboxes, PDF export triggers) MUST have explicit data-testid attributes formatted in lower kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='start-assessment-button', data-testid='option-scale-2', data-testid='download-pdf-report-btn').
interactive_states_and_testing.contrast_rules: Always explicitly define text color on hover/focus states to prevent text invisibility. Use text-slate-900 on mint backgrounds and text-white on teal/indigo backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use plain React JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as per project setup.
Implement Lenis or smooth scrolling for the landing page.
Ensure the PDF report generation (via html2pdf, jspdf, or html2canvas) faithfully renders the 11 report sections including cover, radar chart, theory/activity blocks, and 14-day grid.
Include mock users for quick switching (e.g. Student 1: Ananya Sharma - UG Eng, Student 2: Rohan Verma - PG Mgmt, Admin: Dr. Mehra).
Keep Tele-MANAS helpline 14416 prominently visible in emergency support sections.
Verify that every button, tab, link, input, option button, and checkbox has a unique data-testid attribute.
